newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Adelaide Brighton settles Hawaiian sale.
newsitem.headline: Adelaide Brighton settles Hawaiian sale.

text.p: Cement maker Adelaide Brighton Ltd said on Tuesday it had settled the sale of its interest in Hawaiian Cement, and received the proceeds of US$25.8 million which would be used to retire existing debt.

Adelaide Brighton said in May it had sold its half share in the Hawaiian operation to Knife River Dakota Inc, a subsidiary of U.S. based MDU Resources Group Inc, subject to the satisfaction of certain legal and regulatory requirements.
The company said last week it had agreed to sell its New Zealand Hurricane Wire Products group, the latest in a number of non-core asset disposals. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
